transcript.text: Hello, we're onboarding Smallest AI as a vendor. What documents can you provide?
Hello, this is the Legal Coordination Assistant for Smallest AI. I can help you with our standard NDAs, MSAs, or vendor registration. How can I assist you today?

Great, I can help with that. For vendor registration, we typically provide the Company Registration Certificate, Certificate of Incorporation, GST Certificate, PAN card, Board Resolution, Bank Details, ISO 27001 certificate, SOC 2 Type II report, and our Company Profile. To get this started, could you please share your company name?

Yes, we have ISO 27001 certification, which is currently valid. We can share the certificate directly. To get the full vendor registration package sent over to you, could you please share your company name?
We also need your GST and PAN details.

We can definitely provide those. The legal team can send over the complete vendor registration package, which includes the GST and PAN details, along with the other documents I mentioned. To make sure it goes to the right place, could you please share your company name?
How quickly can you send all this?
The legal team can compile and send the package within 2 business days once we have your company name. Could you please share your company name so I can get this started for you?
